title: The Asian Awakening
description: Follow the spiritual traditions that emerged across Asia, from ancient Vedic hymns to the spread of Buddhism and the wisdom of Taoism and Confucianism.

title: Indigenous Americas
description: Discover the rich spiritual traditions of the Americas, from ancient Olmec shamanism to the magnificent pyramids of the Maya and Aztec.

title: The Norse Saga
description: Journey through the Viking world, from Bronze Age sun worship to the mighty gods of Asgard, the Viking expansion, and the final Christianization of the North.

title: The Abrahamic Path
description: Trace the interconnected story of Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, from ancient Zoroastrian monotheism to the revelation of the Quran.

title: Mystical Pathways
description: Explore the inner dimensions of spirituality through meditation, mysticism, and esoteric practices across different traditions.

title: Ancient Origins
description: Begin at the dawn of human spirituality, from 50,000-year-old Aboriginal Dreamtime to the foundations of world religions.
